'''Mayor Lydia Birkton'''<ref name="Deathcap And Widow's Frill">{{questlong|Alliance|34|Deathcap And Widow's Frill}}</ref> is a [[human]] quest giver located in [[Ambershire]] in [[Northwind]]. Prior to becoming mayor of Ambershire, she was part of [[the Witch of Northwind]]'s coven.<ref name="Deathcap And Widow's Frill" />

==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|34|Unconventional Means}} {{queststart}}

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Dark times are ahead, adventurer. Much of the peace and tranquility that is left in Northwind vanishes with each passing hour. These lands are falling apart and no one seems to care about it. Neither his Lordship nor the King. It falls to me - to the people - to salvage this tragedy that befalls us. Missing people, invading Defias, Blackrocks and Dark Irons, Gnolls running amok, the whole town of Birkhaven in ruins. I have my hands full of problems and none left to grasp at solutions. I implore on your good faith and morals: Please, help the people of Northwind.
